fields.summary_ko.0: Bank of America raised Eli Lilly (LLY) target price from $1,557 to $1,600, representing 19% upside from current price of $1,347, with the stock up 25% in 2026.
fields.summary_ko.1: Lilly's Q3 revenue grew 39%, 2026 guidance was raised from $85–87B to $91–92B, and the target price of $1,600 represents 28x based on 2028 estimates, similar to current trading valuation.
